LanguageData.MX_QH_SpringFlow.label: Spring Flow
LanguageData.MX_QH_SpringFlow.description:
Spend 2 Flower Decree to summon a spring at the target location, briefly healing allies in range and granting Spring Flow Baptism, which increases melee damage, reduces incoming damage and cleanses certain harmful effects. Lasts 15 seconds.
After learning Seasonal Harmony, flesh enemies in the spring gain 20 bleeding buildup per second, or 15 toxin buildup if already bleeding. Mechanoids gain 15 corrosion buildup, or 20 electrical leakage buildup if already corroded. Buildup scales with spell effect factor and the corresponding abnormal application efficiency.
This effect can dispel the Death Sentence applied by Deathflow Field.
LanguageData.MX_QH_LunarMirror.label: Lunar Mirror
LanguageData.MX_QH_LunarMirror.description:
Spend 2 Flower Decree to summon an icy shield at the target location. It briefly intercepts hostile projectiles crossing its boundary, retaliating against each attacker with a frost bullet. The shield lasts 20 seconds and breaks after absorbing a certain amount of damage.
After learning Seasonal Harmony, non-mechanoid enemies inside the shield gain 15 fear buildup per second, while mechanoids gain 15 overload buildup. Frost bullets apply only cold buildup on hit, triggering freezing at the limit. Buildup scales with spell effect factor and the corresponding abnormal application efficiency.
LanguageData.MX_QH_IllusoryReflection.label: Illusory Reflection
LanguageData.MX_QH_IllusoryReflection.description:
Sheathe the blade and stand upon the moon on the water, holding the stance for up to 5 seconds. An attack in that time strikes only a reflection: Qinghe shatters with the water, a circling cut sweeps every enemy within 4.5 cells, gaining Sword Pressure on hit, and she takes shape again from the water.
Invulnerable from the start of the stance to its end; counters only once. The cooldown starts when the stance ends.
—Flowers in the mirror, the moon on the water: naught but a dream.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Zantetsuken_Guren.label: Zantetsuken: Guren
LanguageData.MX_QH_Zantetsuken_Guren.description:
Requires at least 1 Sword Pressure. Dash rapidly in the chosen direction and kick the first enemy or building in the way, stunning every enemy in the lotus (6 cells) at the landing point for 5 seconds. Then spend all Sword Pressure to leap high and drop straight down with the blade held flat, striking every enemy in the lotus 5 times after landing. A dash that hits nothing only dashes and spends no Sword Pressure.
Invulnerable from the dash to the end of the stance.
With Tsubame Gaeshi: Gekka learned, the stun lasts 8 seconds; after landing she does not sheathe, but turns the edge and scoops back up into low air, sheathes in mid-air, and the click of the sheath strikes every enemy in the lotus once more for heavy damage.
